Our team at SCG Services was contracted to perform a comprehensive repair and painting project at Winchester Apartments in Atlanta, GA. This multi-unit residential community required interior and exterior renovations, ensuring a refreshed and modern look for its residents while maintaining the structural integrity of the buildings.
📍 Location: Winchester Apartments, 400 Winchester Trail SE, Atlanta, GA 30339
📅 Project Duration: Still in progress
🛠 Services Provided: Interior & Exterior Painting, General Repairs, Surface Preparation
✅ Interior Painting:
Full-unit repainting, including walls, ceilings, trim, and doors
Color-matching and application of high-quality, low-VOC paint for durability
Accent wall painting as per property management specifications
✅ Exterior Painting:
Repainting of building facades, balconies, stairwells, and common areas
Power washing and surface preparation to remove dirt, mold, and peeling paint
Application of weather-resistant coatings to ensure long-term protection
✅ General Repairs:
Drywall patching and repairs for cracks, holes, and water damage
Baseboard and trim repairs to enhance unit aesthetics
Caulking and sealing around windows and doors to improve insulation
Challenges & Solutions:
🔹 Tenant-Occupied Units: We coordinated work schedules to minimize disruption and completed projects efficiently within designated timeframes.
🔹 Weather Conditions: For exterior painting, we planned around optimal weather windows to ensure proper paint adhesion and long-lasting results.
🔹 Surface Preparation: Several areas required intensive cleaning, patching, and priming before painting to achieve a smooth and professional finish.
Results & Impact:
🏡 Transformed Living Spaces – The newly painted interiors and exteriors enhanced curb appeal and created a fresh, inviting environment for tenants.
🛠 Improved Property Value – The repairs and painting provided long-term protection against wear and tear, increasing the property's overall value and tenant satisfaction.
🎯 On-Time & On-Budget – The project was completed within the scheduled timeframe and budget, exceeding client expectations.
